title: My cosmic thrift store has over 100 fully inspectable 3D books
author: Solto_Games
selftext:
>Hey everyone! I’m kicking off a series of bite-sized videos showing off different mechanics and little details of **Interstellar Consignment Shop**.  
>  
>The main reason? Before I sink hundreds of hours into final 3D art and heavy polish—which is easily the most time-consuming part of dev—I want to make sure the core gameplay is actually fun, intuitive, and heading in the right direction.  
>  
>I really need your honest eyes on this: what looks good, what feels off, and what you’d improve. Once we build up our early community, I’ll be rolling out the closed demo and playtester interviews so we can shape the game together into something everyone truly loves playing.  
>  
>Check out the retro hotsite to inspect the 3D items, and hop into our Discord.  
👾 **Discord community:** [https://discord.gg/MSW69vkppj](https://discord.gg/MSW69vkppj)  
🌐 **Official website (with interactive 3D items):** [https://interstellar-hotsite.vercel.app/](https://interstellar-hotsite.vercel.app/)
